in_sanskrit.name: Ashfak
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Night sky
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashfak एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ashfak is derived from the Persian language and means 'night sky'. In Hindu mythology, Ashfak is associated with the moon and is considered a beautiful and romantic name for a baby boy.
